title: HYLTARP loveseat
description: HYLTARP loveseat, Gransel gray HYLTARP is an inviting family sofa where everyone wants to spend lots of time. It’s very comfy, has all the essential features – and a classic, clean-lined look that is also pleasing on the eye. 10 year Limited warranty. Read about the terms in the warranty brochure.
materialAndCare: Frame: Solid wood, Particleboard, Plywood, Polyurethane foam 1.2 lb/cu.ft., Fiberboard, Laminated veneer lumber; Pocket spring unit/ Metal parts: Steel; Leg: Polypropylene; Seat cushion: Felt liner, High-resilience polyurethane foam (cold foam) 2.2 lb/cu.ft., Polyurethane foam 2.0 lb/cu.ft.; Back cushion/ Lumbar cushion: 100 % polyester - hollow fiber (100% recycled); Back fabric: 100 % polyester (100% recycled); Smolder resistant lining/ Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Back fabric: 100 % polyester (100% recycled); Fabric: 43 % cotton, 27 % viscose/rayon, 18% polyester (min. 90% recycled), 12 % linen
